cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS open_stores FROM analytics.dim_store AS s WHERE s.opened_date <= CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE) AND (s.closed_date IS NULL OR s.closed_date > CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE))
cases.answer: Using the date set in the query, 39 stores are open today.

cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.city) AS cities_with_stores FROM analytics.dim_store AS s JOIN analytics.dim_region AS r ON r.region_id = s.region_id
cases.answer: Perusahaan memiliki toko di 12 kota.

cases.sql: SELECT s.store_name, s.closed_date FROM analytics.dim_store AS s WHERE s.closed_date IS NOT NULL
cases.answer: Arunika Medan Kesawan closed permanently on 2025-06-30.

assumptions: “Most expensive” means the highest list price among active products.
cases.answer: The most expensive active product is Nusantech Headphones R48, with a list price of IDR 11.9M.

cases.sql: SELECT p.promo_code FROM analytics.dim_promotion AS p WHERE p.promo_name LIKE 'Harbolnas 11.11%' ORDER BY p.promo_code
assumptions: Menampilkan kode promo untuk semua tahun yang tersedia.

cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS active_head_office_employees FROM analytics.dim_employee AS e WHERE e.is_active = TRUE AND e.store_id IS NULL
cases.answer: There are 30 active employees at head office rather than in a store.

cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS fully_refunded_orders FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o WHERE o.status = 'refunded' AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2025-12-31' AS DATE)
assumptions: “Fully refunded” means orders with status = 'refunded'.
“Placed in 2025” refers to the WIB calendar year.
cases.answer: There were 310 orders placed in 2025 that were fully refunded, treating “fully refunded” as status = 'refunded' and using the WIB calendar year.

cases.sql: SELECT SUM(oi.discount_idr) AS total_discount_idr FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.fact_order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2024-12-31' AS DATE)
assumptions: Total diskon dihitung sebagai jumlah diskon pada seluruh baris pesanan, dan tanggal pesanan menggunakan tanggal bisnis WIB.
cases.answer: Total diskon yang diberikan pada tahun 2024, tidak termasuk pesanan yang dibatalkan, adalah 1.461.987.700. Perhitungan menjumlahkan diskon pada seluruh baris pesanan dan menggunakan tanggal bisnis WIB.

cases.sql: SELECT courier, ROUND(CAST(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (delivered_at - shipped_at)) / 86400) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_delivery_days FROM analytics.fact_shipments AS fs WHERE shipment_status = 'delivered' GROUP BY courier ORDER BY courier
cases.answer: For delivered parcels, the average elapsed time from shipment to delivery, expressed in days, was 2.85 for AnterAja, 2.84 for GoSend, 2.8 for JNE, 2.84 for J&T Express, and 2.81 for SiCepat.

cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS tickets FROM analytics.fact_support_tickets AS t WHERE t.contact_channel = 'whatsapp' AND CAST((t.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2026-12-31' AS DATE)
cases.answer: 1,231 support tickets were opened through WhatsApp in 2026. The available ticket data ends in September, so the count covers only the data available through that point.

cases.sql: SELECT c.channel_code AS channel, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.fact_order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN analytics.dim_channel AS c ON c.channel_id = o.channel_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2025-12-31' AS DATE) GROUP BY c.channel_code ORDER BY c.channel_code
cases.answer: Pada tahun 2025, unit terjual tanpa pesanan yang dibatalkan per channel adalah: app 12.608 unit, marketplace 8.456 unit, store 38.848 unit, dan website 8.908 unit.

cases.sql: SELECT SUM(t.visitors) AS total_visitors FROM analytics.fact_store_daily_traffic AS t WHERE t.traffic_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND t.traffic_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE)
cases.answer: A total of 291,021 store visitors were recorded during 2025.

cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS open_purchase_orders FROM analytics.fact_purchase_orders AS po WHERE po.po_status = 'open'
cases.answer: There are 55 open purchase orders.

cases.sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(AVG(t.csat_score) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS average_csat_score FROM analytics.fact_support_tickets AS t WHERE t.csat_score IS NOT NULL
assumptions: Only tickets with a recorded CSAT score are included; unrated tickets are excluded.
cases.answer: The average CSAT score across rated support tickets is 3.86. Unrated tickets are excluded.

cases.sql: WITH eligible_orders AS (SELECT o.order_id FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2025-12-31' AS DATE)), category_order_net AS (SELECT oi.order_id, c.category_id, c.category_name AS subcategory, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_idr - oi.discount_idr) AS line_net_idr FROM eligible_orders AS eo JOIN analytics.fact_order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = eo.order_id JOIN analytics.dim_product AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN analytics.dim_category AS c ON c.category_id = p.category_id WHERE c.level = 2 GROUP BY oi.order_id, c.category_id, c.category_name), category_order_refunds AS (SELECT r.order_id, c.category_id, SUM(r.refund_amount_idr) AS refunded_idr FROM eligible_orders AS eo JOIN analytics.fact_returns AS r ON r.order_id = eo.order_id JOIN analytics.fact_order_items AS oi ON oi.order_item_id = r.order_item_id JOIN analytics.dim_product AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN analytics.dim_category AS c ON c.category_id = p.category_id WHERE c.level = 2 GROUP BY r.order_id, c.category_id) SELECT n.subcategory, SUM(n.line_net_idr - COALESCE(r.refunded_idr, 0)) AS net_revenue_idr FROM category_order_net AS n LEFT JOIN category_order_refunds AS r ON r.order_id = n.order_id AND r.category_id = n.category_id GROUP BY n.subcategory ORDER BY net_revenue_idr DESC LIMIT 3
assumptions: Refunds are assigned to the subcategory of the returned order item and attributed to the original order date.
cases.answer: The top subcategories by net revenue in 2025 were Smartphones (IDR 20.1B), Audio (IDR 14.8B), and Computers & Accessories (IDR 11.1B). The query uses WIB order dates and assigns refunds to the returned item's subcategory and original order date.

cases.sql: SELECT s.supplier_name AS supplier_name, CAST(SUM(po.quantity * po.unit_cost_idr) AS BIGINT) AS purchase_order_value_idr FROM analytics.fact_purchase_orders AS po JOIN analytics.dim_supplier AS s ON s.supplier_id = po.supplier_id WHERE po.po_status <> 'cancelled' AND po.ordered_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND po.ordered_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY s.supplier_id, s.supplier_name ORDER BY purchase_order_value_idr DESC LIMIT 5
assumptions: Nilai PO dihitung sebagai jumlah unit dikali biaya per unit; tahun 2025 ditentukan dari tanggal PO (ordered_date).
cases.answer: Dengan mengecualikan PO yang dibatalkan dan menghitung nilai PO sebagai jumlah unit dikali biaya per unit, pemasok dengan nilai terbesar berturut-turut adalah PD Fujiati Hidayat (Persero) Tbk (01) (Rp 5,75 miliar), UD Hutapea Tbk (03) (Rp 3,22 miliar), CV Dongoran Salahudin (02) (Rp 2,79 miliar), PT Rahimah (Persero) Tbk (04) (Rp 1,52 miliar), dan Perum Zulkarnain (14) (Rp 1,27 miliar). Tahun ditentukan berdasarkan tanggal pemesanan PO.

cases.sql: SELECT s.store_format, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.dim_store AS s ON s.store_id = o.store_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2025-12-31' AS DATE) GROUP BY s.store_format ORDER BY s.store_format
assumptions: Orders are attributed to the format of the store that sold or fulfilled them; refunded orders are included because only cancelled orders are excluded.
cases.answer: In 2025, flagship stores had 1,648 orders, mall stores had 13,733, and street stores had 6,019, excluding cancelled orders.

cases.sql: SELECT cst.region_id AS customer_city_id, COUNT(*) AS online_orders FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.dim_channel AS ch ON ch.channel_id = o.channel_id JOIN analytics.dim_customer AS cst ON cst.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE ch.is_online AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2026-09-30' AS DATE) GROUP BY cst.region_id ORDER BY online_orders DESC LIMIT 1
assumptions: Hitung pesanan online dari pelanggan terdaftar; kota pelanggan diwakili oleh region_id karena nama kota tidak tersedia pada view yang diberikan.
Data 2026 hanya mencakup 1 Januari sampai 30 September.
cases.answer: Customer region ID 1 had the most online orders, with 2,139. The query counts orders from registered customers, uses region ID as a proxy for city, and covers the period through the end of September.

cases.sql: SELECT s.store_name, COUNT(*) AS zero_stock_snapshots FROM analytics.fact_inventory_daily AS i JOIN analytics.dim_store AS s ON s.store_id = i.store_id WHERE i.snapshot_date BETWEEN CAST('2026-09-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2026-09-30' AS DATE) AND i.on_hand_qty = 0 GROUP BY s.store_name ORDER BY zero_stock_snapshots DESC, s.store_name LIMIT 1
assumptions: “Paling sering kehabisan stok” diartikan sebagai jumlah snapshot akhir hari produk dengan stok 0 per toko selama September 2026.
cases.answer: Toko Arunika Bekasi Cikarang paling sering kehabisan stok, dengan 88 snapshot akhir hari produk bersaldo nol selama September 2026.

cases.sql: SELECT e.employee_code, COUNT(*) AS completed_in_store_orders FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.dim_employee AS e ON e.employee_id = o.sales_employee_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND e.job_role = 'sales_associate' AND o.sales_employee_id IS NOT NULL AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY e.employee_code ORDER BY completed_in_store_orders DESC LIMIT 1
assumptions: In-store orders are identified by a non-NULL sales_employee_id, as online orders have no sales employee.
2025 is interpreted as the WIB calendar year.
cases.answer: Employee code EMP-00233 served the most completed in-store orders in 2025, with 152 orders.

cases.sql: SELECT r.region_group AS region_group, COUNT(c.customer_id) AS registered_customers FROM analytics.dim_customer AS c JOIN analytics.dim_region AS r ON r.region_id = c.region_id GROUP BY r.region_group ORDER BY r.region_group
assumptions: Use each customer's recorded city to determine their region group.
cases.answer: Registered customers by region group: Bali—975, Jabodetabek—9,663, Jawa Barat—1,950, Jawa Tengah & DIY—2,478, Jawa Timur—2,612, Sulawesi—1,146, and Sumatera—1,176. Region groups are assigned using each customer's recorded city.

cases.sql: SELECT p.promo_name, COUNT(*) AS redemptions FROM analytics.fact_promotion_redemptions AS r JOIN analytics.dim_promotion AS p ON p.promotion_id = r.promotion_id GROUP BY p.promo_name ORDER BY redemptions DESC LIMIT 1
assumptions: A redemption is one recorded row in fact_promotion_redemptions.
cases.answer: The promotion redeemed most was Ramadan Sale 2026, with 1,301 redemptions; each recorded row was counted as one redemption.

cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o WHERE CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST('2025-03-31' AS DATE) AND CAST('2025-04-06' AS DATE)
assumptions: Count all orders placed in the stated WIB date range, including cancelled orders.
cases.answer: There were 281 orders placed during the Lebaran week, counting all orders in the stated WIB date range, including cancelled orders.

cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o WHERE CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) = CAST('2024-12-12' AS DATE)
assumptions: Menghitung semua pesanan pada tanggal tersebut, termasuk yang dibatalkan.
cases.answer: Jumlah pesanan pada tanggal yang ditanyakan adalah 91, termasuk pesanan yang dibatalkan.

cases.sql: WITH monthly AS (SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST('2026-08-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2026-08-31' AS DATE)) AS august_orders, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST('2026-09-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2026-09-30' AS DATE)) AS september_orders FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o WHERE CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST('2026-08-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2026-09-30' AS DATE)) SELECT august_orders, september_orders, september_orders - august_orders AS order_delta FROM monthly
assumptions: Count all orders, including cancelled orders.
The change is September orders minus August orders, so a negative value means orders decreased.
cases.answer: Including cancelled orders, the order count changed by -4 orders from August to September (September minus August).

cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o WHERE CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2025-12-31' AS DATE) AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS TIME) >= CAST('00:00' AS TIME) AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS TIME) < CAST('06:00' AS TIME)
assumptions: Count all orders, including cancelled orders, because the question does not specify a status.
Interpret “between midnight and 6 a.m.” as from 00:00 inclusive to 06:00 exclusive in Jakarta time.
cases.answer: There were 864 orders in 2025 placed from midnight inclusive to 6 a.m. exclusive Jakarta time, including cancelled orders.

cases.sql: SELECT SUM(t.visitors) AS visitors FROM analytics.fact_store_daily_traffic AS t JOIN analytics.dim_date AS d ON d.date_key = t.traffic_date WHERE t.traffic_date BETWEEN CAST('2026-07-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2026-07-31' AS DATE) AND d.is_weekend = TRUE
assumptions: Akhir pekan berarti hari Sabtu dan Minggu, sesuai penanda is_weekend.
cases.answer: Total pengunjung toko pada akhir pekan di bulan Juli 2026 adalah 7.486, dengan akhir pekan diartikan sebagai hari Sabtu dan Minggu.

cases.sql: WITH order_net AS (SELECT o.order_id, CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) AS order_date, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_idr - oi.discount_idr) AS line_net FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.fact_order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2026-06-30' AS DATE) GROUP BY o.order_id, CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE)), refunds AS (SELECT r.order_id, SUM(r.refund_amount_idr) AS refunded FROM analytics.fact_returns AS r GROUP BY r.order_id), order_revenue AS (SELECT n.order_date, n.line_net - COALESCE(r.refunded, 0) AS net_revenue_idr FROM order_net AS n LEFT JOIN refunds AS r ON r.order_id = n.order_id) SELECT 'calendar_q1_2026' AS period, SUM(net_revenue_idr) AS net_revenue_idr FROM order_revenue WHERE order_date BETWEEN CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2026-03-31' AS DATE) UNION ALL SELECT 'fiscal_q1_fy2026' AS period, SUM(net_revenue_idr) AS net_revenue_idr FROM order_revenue WHERE order_date BETWEEN CAST('2026-04-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2026-06-30' AS DATE)
cases.answer: Net revenue was IDR 17.8B for calendar_q1_2026 and IDR 19.9B for fiscal_q1_fy2026.

cases.sql: WITH quarters AS (SELECT 1 AS calendar_quarter, CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AS quarter_start, CAST('2025-04-01' AS DATE) AS next_quarter_start UNION ALL SELECT 2, CAST('2025-04-01' AS DATE), CAST('2025-07-01' AS DATE) UNION ALL SELECT 3, CAST('2025-07-01' AS DATE), CAST('2025-10-01' AS DATE) UNION ALL SELECT 4, CAST('2025-10-01' AS DATE), CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE)) SELECT q.calendar_quarter, COUNT(c.customer_id) AS new_customers FROM quarters AS q LEFT JOIN analytics.dim_customer AS c ON c.signup_date >= q.quarter_start AND c.signup_date < q.next_quarter_start GROUP BY q.calendar_quarter ORDER BY q.calendar_quarter
assumptions: Calendar quarter means standard calendar quarters (Jan–Mar, Apr–Jun, Jul–Sep, Oct–Dec).
cases.answer: Using standard calendar quarters, new customers signed up were: quarter 1, 1,263; quarter 2, 1,367; quarter 3, 1,442; and quarter 4, 1,428.

cases.sql: SELECT CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) AS order_date, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o WHERE CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2025-12-31' AS DATE) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY orders DESC, order_date ASC LIMIT 1
assumptions: Interpreted “receive orders” as orders placed, grouped by their WIB order date; counted all orders, including cancelled ones.
cases.answer: The highest order volume in 2025 was on 2025-11-11, with 183 orders. This counts all orders, including cancelled orders, by their WIB order date.

cases.sql: WITH order_net AS (SELECT o.order_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_idr - oi.discount_idr) AS line_net FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.fact_order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST('2025-04-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2026-03-31' AS DATE) GROUP BY o.order_id), refunds AS (SELECT r.order_id, SUM(r.refund_amount_idr) AS refunded FROM analytics.fact_returns AS r GROUP BY r.order_id) SELECT SUM(n.line_net - COALESCE(r.refunded, 0)) AS net_revenue_idr FROM order_net AS n LEFT JOIN refunds AS r ON r.order_id = n.order_id
assumptions: Refunds are attributed to the order date, and cancelled orders are excluded.
cases.answer: Total net revenue in FY2025 was IDR 74B. This uses the FY2025 period from April through March; refunds are attributed to the order date, and cancelled orders are excluded.

cases.sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_idr) AS gross_sales_idr FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.fact_order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2025-12-31' AS DATE)
assumptions: Gross sales means order-line value at selling price before discounts and refunds, excluding cancelled orders.
cases.answer: Gross sales selama tahun kalender 2025 adalah Rp 78,1 miliar, dihitung sebagai nilai baris pesanan pada harga jual sebelum diskon dan refund, dengan pesanan yang dibatalkan dikecualikan.

cases.sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(SUM(o.total_amount) AS DECIMAL) / COUNT(*)) AS aov_idr FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.dim_channel AS c ON c.channel_id = o.channel_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND c.channel_code = 'app' AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2026-09-30' AS DATE)
cases.answer: The average order value of non-cancelled app orders was IDR 3.4M for the available 2026 data through the end of September.

cases.sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(AVG(CAST(s.converted AS INT)) AS DECIMAL), 4) AS conversion_rate FROM analytics.fact_web_sessions AS s JOIN analytics.dim_channel AS c ON c.channel_id = s.channel_id WHERE c.channel_code = 'app' AND CAST((s.started_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST((s.started_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE)
cases.answer: Tingkat konversi sesi di aplikasi selama tahun 2025 adalah 8,3%.

cases.sql: SELECT c.channel_code AS channel, ROUND(CAST(COALESCE(SUM(r.returned_units), 0) AS DECIMAL) / NULLIF(SUM(oi.quantity), 0), 4) AS return_rate FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.dim_channel AS c ON c.channel_id = o.channel_id JOIN analytics.fact_order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT order_item_id, SUM(quantity) AS returned_units FROM analytics.fact_returns GROUP BY order_item_id) AS r ON r.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2025-12-31' AS DATE) GROUP BY c.channel_code ORDER BY c.channel_code
assumptions: Return rate uses returned units divided by sold units, excluding cancelled orders, consistent with the canonical metric.
Channels with orders in 2025 are included; rates are grouped by channel code.
cases.answer: For orders placed in 2025, return rates were app: 5.5%, marketplace: 4.2%, store: 3.9%, and website: 5.3%. Rates use returned units divided by sold units and exclude cancelled orders.

cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS active_customers FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.customer_id IS NOT NULL AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) > CAST('2026-06-30' AS DATE) - 90 AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) <= CAST('2026-06-30' AS DATE)
cases.answer: There were 2,911 active customers as of the requested date, counting customers with a completed order during the preceding period.

cases.sql: WITH order_net AS (SELECT o.order_id, r.region_group, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_idr - oi.discount_idr) AS line_net FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.fact_order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN analytics.dim_store AS s ON s.store_id = o.store_id JOIN analytics.dim_region AS r ON r.region_id = s.region_id JOIN analytics.dim_date AS d ON d.date_key = CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND d.fiscal_year = 2025 GROUP BY o.order_id, r.region_group), refunds AS (SELECT fr.order_id, SUM(fr.refund_amount_idr) AS refunded FROM analytics.fact_returns AS fr GROUP BY fr.order_id) SELECT n.region_group, SUM(n.line_net - COALESCE(r.refunded, 0)) AS net_revenue_idr FROM order_net AS n LEFT JOIN refunds AS r ON r.order_id = n.order_id GROUP BY n.region_group ORDER BY n.region_group
cases.answer: Pada FY2025, pendapatan bersih per region group adalah: Bali Rp 3,47 miliar, Jabodetabek Rp 36,7 miliar, Jawa Barat Rp 6,36 miliar, Jawa Tengah & DIY Rp 10,2 miliar, Jawa Timur Rp 9,95 miliar, Sulawesi Rp 3,54 miliar, dan Sumatera Rp 3,82 miliar.

cases.sql: WITH order_net AS (SELECT o.order_id, o.store_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_idr - oi.discount_idr) AS line_net FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.fact_order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) >= CAST('2026-09-01' AS DATE) AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) < CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY o.order_id, o.store_id), refunds AS (SELECT r.order_id, SUM(r.refund_amount_idr) AS refunded FROM analytics.fact_returns AS r GROUP BY r.order_id) SELECT s.store_name, SUM(n.line_net - COALESCE(r.refunded, 0)) AS net_revenue_idr FROM order_net AS n LEFT JOIN refunds AS r ON r.order_id = n.order_id JOIN analytics.dim_store AS s ON s.store_id = n.store_id GROUP BY s.store_name ORDER BY net_revenue_idr DESC LIMIT 1
assumptions: September 2026 means the full WIB calendar month.

assumptions: Interpreted “2025” as calendar year 2025 and “subcategories” as level-2 product categories.
cases.answer: Assuming 2025 means the calendar year and subcategories are level-two product categories, the top subcategories by net revenue were Smartphones (IDR 20.1B), Audio (IDR 14.8B), and Computers & Accessories (IDR 11.1B).
